## Batch 68 authored

Created all six draft items: the score definition, probability-flow theorem, predictor–corrector algorithm, and three examples. The A/B manifest contains three items per page, with no summary fields. Batch dependency levels are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 4.

The authoring record and evidence are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-68.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-68.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-68.proof-contracts.json), [source evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-68.source-evidence.json), and [cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-68.cross-batch-dependencies.json). The sources recorded include [Song et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.13456), [Särkkä–Solin](https://users.aalto.fi/~asolin/sde-book/sde-book.pdf), [Raginsky](https://maxim.ece.illinois.edu/teaching/spring23/SDE_book.pdf), and [Durmus–Moulines](https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.05021).

## Validation and open issues

Precheck passed for all four proof-bearing items; proof-layout passed for all six items with 15 steps and no defects; strict proof-contract validation passed 6/6; rendercheck passed all six; source-fetch check verified 7/7 rows. The six batch items’ dependency levels match the full run graph. The full-run dependency check still reports nine errors in other batches’ scaffolds.

The predictor–corrector algorithm and its two dependent examples remain escalated: the batch-67 reversal theorem’s Statement omits AC, although its Facts and proof use AC. Those cross-batch edges are open. The dispatch scheduling hash also differs from the dependency-level artifact’s recorded hash; batch level 3 and prerequisite batch 67 agree.

## Step-1 records blocked

I attempted to record all six decisions without `--owner`, but the recorder failed before writing any records with `Duplicate item undefined`. Its full-run loader encounters batch 71 pages whose `items` entries are strings rather than item objects. I documented the affected entries, blocker, and intended item decisions in the notes. No batch-71 files or autopilot state were changed.
